## WireError type

Wire form of a structured error.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type WireError = {
  readonly [C in WireErrorCode]: {
    readonly code: C
    readonly message: string
    readonly details: ErrorDetailsByCode[C]
  }
}[WireErrorCode]
```

**References:** [WireErrorCode](./contracts.wireerrorcode.md)<!-- -->, [ErrorDetailsByCode](./contracts.errordetailsbycode.md)

## Remarks

Clients choose the class to reconstruct from `code`<!-- -->, never from the HTTP status. An unknown code, or details that fail their code's schema, reconstruct as a transport failure with reason `'protocol-mismatch'`<!-- -->.
